note: Direct extraction of every combat-relevant number in the repo, with provenance. 'code' = implemented in shared/ or src/ (authoritative), 'doc' = design-doc canon not yet in code, 'assumed' = scaffold value this sheet needs but nothing in the repo defines — flagged so a tuning pass knows what is real.

pipeline.formula: Hit = Base × Beat × (1 + 0.06 × Marks) × (1 + Amp) × Gear × Format

slotMap.damageGap: Only S1 and S4 have canon damage numbers for most heroes. Doc 03 gives S2/S3 damage for the chain kits only (Skinner Consequence 175, Pavlov UCS 145 / NS 20). Every other S2/S3 damage number is a design proposal generated by the sheet's coefficient knobs.

difficultyTiers.note: No doc defines difficulty tiers. The sheet proposes three per boss (Standard / Hard / Nightmare) sharing one phase script, each with its own derived hpByTeamSize, outgoing-damage / regen / answer-window multipliers, and a target kill time as a fraction of the enrage timer. The tuning corners are 3-or-5 players × gear ×1.00 or ×1.12. Consequence worth knowing before writing the tiers: gear is capped at +12% (~11% of kill time), so slack-vs-enrage is the ONLY lever that can lock an under-geared group out, and boss-damage multipliers cannot gate anyone while no hero HP exists to die.
